qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the output flange collar nut on A5S 300J transmissions?
What torque should be applied to the output flange collar nut on all other automatic transmission types?
Which component is referenced as 1AZ in the automatic transmission torque specifications?
What section of the service manual contains these automatic transmission torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: 24-6 Automatic Transmission, section 24 21 Input, Intermediate and Output Shafts

qa_pairs.question: How much higher is the torque specification for the A5S 300J output flange collar nut compared to all other transmission types?
qa_pairs.answer: The A5S 300J requires 125 Nm more torque (225 Nm vs 100 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: What unit of measurement is used for all the torque specifications shown on this page?
Which automatic transmission type requires the higher torque specification for the output flange collar nut?
qa_pairs.answer: A5S 300J transmission requires the higher torque specification

qa_pairs.question: Are there different torque specifications for the same component depending on the transmission type?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the output flange collar nut has different torque specifications: 225 Nm for A5S 300J and 100 Nm for all others

qa_pairs.question: What category of automatic transmission components does this torque specification apply to?
